Statement: Primary research question: how to improve cross-generator generalization of image-based AI face detection models to maintain high accuracy on unseen generative architectures.
Notes: Selected Generalization Focus (Option 1) over Explainability-only and Adversarial-only scopes.

Statement: Three sub-questions investigate (1) forensic artifacts shared across GANs and diffusion models, (2) degradation on novel generators, and (3) regularization and data augmentation strategies mitigating generator overfitting.
Notes: Anchors literature review and empirical evaluation phases E7-E10.

Statement: Human-ratified Direction 1 builds the AI Forensic Analyst as an evidence-driven multi-stream forensic system for cross-generator synthetic face detection rather than a standalone classifier.
Notes: Subsumes hybrid features (Dir. 2), bias auditing (Dir. 3), hierarchical attribution (Dir. 4), and robustness (Dir. 5).

Statement: Strict public-only dataset governance restricts selection to open-license datasets (MIT, CC BY, CC BY-NC) and excludes gated or EULA-restricted sources (Guarnera MFD, FaceForensics++, AI-Face-FairnessBench).
Notes: Resolves DEF-003; replaced EULA-gated AI-Face-FairnessBench with FairFace (CC BY 4.0) for DS0005.

Statement: Systematic literature review synthesizes 28 peer-reviewed papers (P0001-P0028, 2020-2026): 4 critical, 8 high, 10 medium, and 6 low relevance, passing Literature Gate (Checklist 2).
Notes: Critical papers: P0007, P0016, P0018, P0023; TAB0001 compares 16 primary detection methods.

Statement: Prior literature establishes severe cross-paradigm degradation when GAN-trained detectors face diffusion images (sub-30% binary accuracy on DiFF in P0023; EfficientNet-B4 dropping to 86.75% in P0016; 60-70% cross-dataset in P0007).
Notes: GAP0001 is the highest-frequency gap (11 supporting papers).

Statement: Frequency-domain and convolutional trace methods (Synthbuster FFT residuals in P0003, DCT beta statistics in P0010, EM transposed-convolution traces in P0005) yield interpretable evidence but remain paradigm-specific and compression-sensitive.
Notes: Motivates multi-evidence fusion across spatial and frequency streams.

Statement: Benchmark synthetic-face datasets contain low-level statistical shortcuts (background noise, color, compression) that inflate metrics, evidenced by a zero-learning audit achieving 85% accuracy on AI-Face-FairnessBench (P0016).
Notes: Justifies multi-dataset cross-domain auditing and FairFace bias benchmarking.

Statement: Hierarchical multi-level attribution (ResNet-101, 97%+ on proprietary 83k GAN+DM dataset in P0018), patch-wise ViTs (99.9% F1 on 2-generator split in P0021), and self-supervised DINO/CLIP pretraining (P0007) advance detection but lack open cross-dataset proof.
Notes: P0018 dataset is proprietary and hierarchical cascades propagate Level-1 errors.

Statement: Alternative paradigms include physiological iris/pupil biometrics (GLFNet P0015, GAN inversion P0008), diffusion reconstruction error (P0006), and proactive GAN watermarking (P0020), constrained by generator realism (P0025), latency, or creator cooperation.
Notes: Informs contextual biometric/artifact collectors and reactive vs proactive scope boundary.

Statement: Lossy JPEG compression, resizing, social media re-encoding, and anti-forensic fingerprint removal degrade forensic detectors by erasing high-frequency traces, with spatial gradients degrading slightly less than pure spectral detectors.
Notes: Directly motivates the 54-condition Phase E7 perturbation benchmark.

Statement: Prior detection explainability is largely limited to post-hoc heatmaps (Grad-CAM in P0016 revealing shortcut attention) or single-domain traces; no prior work unifies independent collectors, validation, fusion, calibrated confidence, and case reporting.
Notes: GAP0003 is the second critical gap (9 supporting papers), directly motivating MOD001-MOD018.

Statement: High-citation deepfake surveys (P0024 with 285 citations; P0028 with 254 citations; P0022; P0026; P0027) predominantly predate diffusion-era face benchmarks and leave GAN-vs-diffusion synthesis fragmented.
Notes: Supports positioning Chapter 2 as a diffusion-era synthesis.

Statement: Five public datasets (v1.0) are registered and validated (Checklist 3 PASS): DS0001 ArtiFact face subset (50,000; 25k/25k; 13 generators), DS0002 DiFF official test (60,244 raw / 51,452 processed fake-only; 13 diffusion methods), DS0003 140k Real & Fake (70k/70k), DS0004 Synthbuster (9,999; 999 RAISE / 9,000 synth), DS0005 FairFace (97,698 real; 7 race groups).
Supporting Entity: DS0001; DS0002; DS0003; DS0004; DS0005; 03_Datasets/metadata/datasets.csv; 03_Datasets/reports/dataset_report.md; FIG0001-FIG0010
Notes: DS0002 had 1,593 CORRUPT_IMAGE and 461 DUPLICATE_HASH entries filtered via exclude_list_DS0002.csv while preserving raw data untouched.

Statement: Versioned preprocessing pipelines (PP0001-PP0003, PP0005-PP0006 complete; PP0004 superseded by PP0006 for RAISE max_side=8192) standardize 224x224 bilinear RGB PNG images with EXIF stripped and generative denoising forbidden, yielding 10 leakage-checked splits (SPLIT0001 grouped random; SPLIT0002 LOGO).
Supporting Entity: PP0001; PP0002; PP0003; PP0004; PP0005; PP0006; SPLIT0001; SPLIT0002; 04_Preprocessing/preprocessing_registry.csv; 03_Datasets/metadata/split_registry.csv; 03_Datasets/reports/split_report.md
Notes: 34 preprocessing unit tests PASS; Checklist 4 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-09-01).

Statement: Seven candidate backbones (MODEL0001-MODEL0007) were evaluated; shortlist is ResNet-50 (MODEL0001), Xception (MODEL0002), and EfficientNet-B4 (MODEL0003), with EXP0001 locked to ResNet-50 on DS0001/v1.0/PP0001/SPLIT0001 and pre-training sanity bar ROC-AUC >= 0.95 / BA >= 0.90 (pipeline-failure line < 0.90).
Notes: Thresholds selected on validation split only (max balanced accuracy) and frozen prior to test evaluation.

Statement: Reproducible training runs on locked Kaggle Tesla T4 runtime (Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128, FastAI 2.8.7) using immutable YAML configs (47 validator tests), SHA-256 resumable checkpoints, session-tagged live CSV/event logs, and GitHub-as-source-of-truth sync.
Notes: Checklists 5 and 6 PASS; processed image data stored on Kaggle only (Storage Policy A.6).

Statement: Evaluation protocol spans Phases E1-E18 (EVAL0001-EVAL0007): prediction validation, multi-metric classification, E4 calibration & E5 val-only operating points, E6/E12 failure taxonomy, E7 54-condition robustness, E8 cross-dataset, E9 unseen-generator LOGO (DEC0007), E10 one-factor ablations (DEC0008), E11 paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, Bonferroni) & exact McNemar, and E14 whole-platform evaluation.
Notes: Checklist 8 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-11-17); accuracy is never reported alone.

Statement: The AI Forensic Analyst implements 18 decoupled modules (MOD001-MOD018): intake (MOD001), image validation (MOD002), 9 independent non-DL collectors (MOD003), isolated DL specialist (MOD004), append-only EV registry (MOD005), reliability validation (MOD006), swappable fusion (MOD007), evidence-only decision (MOD008), 4-metric confidence (MOD009), A.9 explainability (MOD010), EV-verified reasoning (MOD011), reporting (MOD012), REST API (MOD013), React UI (MOD014), audit (MOD015), failure handling (MOD016), and registry/extensibility (MOD017-MOD018).
Notes: All 18 modules implemented; MOD004 emits P(fake) only and never issues Real/Fake verdicts.

Statement: MOD007 resolves DEF-004 with swappable FusionStrategy (rule_based first, DEC0009): weights MOD006 reliability (high 1.0, medium 0.6, low 0.3, unusable excluded), compares detector probability against recorded E4 threshold (0.3951 for MODEL0001), cites non-directional evidence as context, flags contested band |balance| < 0.5, and outputs a validated fused_conclusion without decision words.
Notes: Unknown strategy ID triggers MOD016 with zero silent fallback.

Statement: MOD009 (e4_calibrated_v1, DEC0010) computes four distinct confidences: prediction_confidence (EVAL0001 val-split empirical accuracy lookup, never raw softmax), evidence_confidence (reliability mean halved on conflict), system_confidence (usable/attempted collector ratio), and decision_confidence (0.5/0.3/0.2 weighted, capped at min(evidence, system) when <= 0.5); MOD008 reads validated EV IDs only to emit Real, Fake, Inconclusive, or Unknown.
Notes: Missing detector yields Unknown with null prediction/decision confidence; conflict or decision_confidence < 0.50 yields Inconclusive.

Statement: MOD010 assembles data-only explanation.json (grad_cam, attention_maps, saliency, integrated_gradients; future shap/lime/counterfactuals) marking absent maps as no_data and forbidding rendered images (A.9); MOD011 generates reasoning.json where verify_sentence checks every sentence against cited EV IDs and recorded values, rejecting ungrounded text via MOD016.
Notes: Enforces zero-hallucination forensic reasoning.

Statement: MOD012 exports reproducible JSON, Markdown (Template 24), and HTML case reports with byte-identical system, model, dataset, experiment, and Git commit stamps; MOD015 appends immutable CASExxxxxx audit rows to case_registry.csv for completed and failed runs; MOD016 classifies all 8 canonical failure modes.
Notes: Failed intake/validation stops produce no decision.json or report while preserving audit traceability.

Statement: MOD013 implements a 7-app Django + DRF REST backend (core, forensic_engine, evidence, reports, health, versioning, api) exposing 10 canonical endpoints at / and /api/v1/, wrapping pipeline.py with thread/eager async jobs, zero duplicated forensic logic, 7 rotating log channels, and MOD016 error envelopes with zero stack traces.
Notes: Checklist 11 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-11-19); /decision returns byte-identical decision.json.

Statement: MOD014 implements a React 18 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 3.4 web application with 14 canonical pages, 24 reusable accessible components, centralized src/api/ client (zero direct fetch calls outside src/api/), 9 investigation progress labels, 4-way verdict presentation, 4 calibrated confidence gauges (Empty when null), EV citations, and explicit limitations.
Notes: Checklist 10 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-11-19); offline API or MOD016 errors never substitute fallback verdicts.

Statement: Cross-tier integration, unified testing (17_Automation/run_all_tests.py), automated 6-scenario UAT (17_Automation/run_uat.py), and full documentation suite (16_Documentation/) verify the end-to-end platform and pass Documentation Gate (Checklist 12).
Notes: Checklist 12 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-11-19).

Statement: EXP0001 (MODEL0001, ResNet-50, 36.7 min on Tesla T4, best epoch 7) achieves on DS0001 SPLIT0001 test (n=7,505) at val-frozen threshold 0.3951: ROC-AUC 0.9261, PR-AUC 0.9348, balanced accuracy 0.8483, F1 0.8442, MCC 0.6978, FNR 0.1829, FPR 0.1205, accuracy 0.8481.
Notes: Below DEC0006 0.95/0.90 sanity bar and above 0.90 pipeline-failure line; reported as observed.

Statement: EVAL0001 calibration on SPLIT0001 test yields ECE 0.0525, MCE 0.1544, Brier 0.1128 (reference 0.2500), and log loss 0.3672; mean confidence (0.8785) exceeds accuracy (0.8481) by >0.02 in 6/10 bins. Val-chosen operating points: frozen 0.3951, screening 0.0894 (FNR 0.055, FPR 0.385), flag-for-review 0.6288 (FNR 0.279, FPR 0.056).
Notes: Demonstrates why raw P(fake) cannot be presented as forensic certainty and feeds MOD009 val lookup.

Statement: EVAL0001 failure analysis (E6/E12) shows fake FNR spans 0.0% (stargan, cips) to 43.7% (stylegan3), 42.1% (projected_gan), 38.3% (stylegan2), and 38.2% (mat), while real-source FPR is 36.7% (metfaces), 14.6% (ffhq), and 7.0% (celebahq); 33.7% of false negatives occur at confidence >= 0.9.
Notes: 29.6% of false positives lie within 0.1 of threshold vs 20.7% of false negatives.

Statement: Phase E7 robustness across 53 perturbations on SPLIT0001 test (n=7,505) shows severe collapse under fine-detail loss: low_quality_upload@0.35_30 BA 0.4999 (delta -0.3485, ROC-AUC 0.5314), resolution@0.35 BA 0.5000, gaussian_blur@2 BA 0.5039, gaussian_noise@0.1 BA 0.5043, jpeg@10 BA 0.6014, driving FPR toward 1.0 (predicting fake); photometric and small rotation shifts drop BA by <0.10.
Notes: 12 perturbations show ranking_loss and 3 show threshold_shift; clean check max diff 3.61e-5 with 0 flips.

Statement: Phase E8 cross-dataset evaluation of MODEL0001 at frozen threshold 0.3951 shows unseen-generator FNR rising to 48.1% (DS0002 DiFF FNR 50.2%, up to 81.5% on FreeDoM_I) vs 18.3% in-distribution and 9.9% on related generators (DS0003 StyleGAN FNR 9.2%), while external real images suffer extreme false positives: FPR 30.4% (DS0003 FFHQ), 76.7% (DS0004 RAISE scenes; ROC-AUC 0.5172), and 82.6% (DS0005 FairFace).
Supporting Entity: EXP0001; EVAL0001; DS0002; DS0003; DS0004; DS0005; 08_Evaluation/EVAL0001/generalization/cross_dataset_report.md; FIG0018; CLAIM0001; CLAIM0003
Notes: Empirically confirms CLAIM0001 and CLAIM0003 on public benchmarks.

Statement: Phase E9 leave-one-generator-out experiment (EXP0002 / MODEL0008 on SPLIT0002, stable_diffusion held out) achieves 0.937 val ROC-AUC (83.3% recall on 12 seen generators, 88.6% real specificity) but drops to 15.2% recall (293/1,923; 95% CI 13.7%-16.9%) on unseen stable_diffusion; on the identical 299 test images, MODEL0001 (seen) achieves 96.3% recall vs MODEL0008 (unseen) 13.7%.
Supporting Entity: EXP0002; MODEL0008; EVAL0002; EXP0001; MODEL0001; DEC0007; 08_Evaluation/EVAL0002/unseen_generator/unseen_report.md; FIG0019; CLAIM0001
Notes: 247 of 299 images detected only when stable_diffusion was seen in training, 0 only by unseen model.

Statement: Phase E10 one-factor ablations on SPLIT0001 establish seed noise floor via EXP0003 (seed 43, ROC-AUC 0.9272, delta +0.0011) and show larger drops from removing augmentation (EXP0004: 0.8925, delta -0.0336, early stop epoch 3), removing ImageNet pretraining (EXP0005: 0.7017, delta -0.2243), and reducing input size to 160 px (EXP0006: 0.8885, delta -0.0376).
Supporting Entity: EXP0001; EXP0003; EXP0004; EXP0005; EXP0006; MODEL0009-MODEL0012; EVAL0003-EVAL0006; DEC0008; 08_Evaluation/ablations/ablation_report.md; FIG0020; TAB0002
Notes: ImageNet pretraining is the largest single contributor under the 11-epoch budget.

Statement: Phase E11 paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, Bonferroni family-wise alpha 0.05) and exact McNemar tests (n=7,505) confirm EXP0003 is indistinguishable from EXP0001 (95% CI [-0.0012, +0.0035], McNemar p=0.964, agreement 0.9334, kappa 0.8662) whereas EXP0004/EXP0005/EXP0006 adjusted 98.3% CIs exclude zero (McNemar adj p <= 1.36e-21); superiority_claim remains none on every row.
Notes: EXP0002 excluded from ranked table due to different split (SPLIT0002); Wilcoxon not run (n=2 seeds < 6).

Statement: Phase E14 whole-platform evaluation (EVAL0007, 16 scenarios: 8 canonical EXP0001 cases + 8 fault/conflict cases) passes 9/9 dimensions: 10/10 collectors registered (24 EV rows/case), 12/12 fusion and confidence consistency, 16/16 decision consistency, 135 verified reasoning sentences (0 ungrounded), mean latency 60.02 ms (max 149.08 ms), 8/8 canonical failure modes structured, 7/7 fault recoveries.
Notes: Checklist 9 PASS (human-confirmed 2026-11-18).

Statement: EVAL0007 empirically verifies detector-decision separation: in E14-10 (P(fake)=0.99, prediction_confidence=0.971745) unusable supporting evidence drops evidence_confidence and system_confidence to 0.333333, causing MOD008 to emit Inconclusive rather than Fake; in E14-11/E14-12 (model_unavailable/timeout), MOD008 emits Unknown with null prediction/decision confidence.
Notes: Direct proof that the forensic analyst prevents blind propagation of unverified high-confidence scores.

Statement: Consolidated cross-tier verification (17_Automation/run_all_tests.py) passes all tiers: 55 forensic unit/integration tests, 18 backend API/smoke/regression/CORS tests, 12 frontend Vitest suites, Vite production build, live HTTP React-to-Django integration, and 6 live UAT scenarios (UAT-01 through UAT-06).
Notes: Verifies complete operational readiness across MOD001-MOD018.

Statement: Reframes synthetic face detection from a monolithic binary classifier into an 18-module evidence-driven forensic analyst (MOD001-MOD018) in which the deep learning detector (MOD004) acts as one replaceable specialist among 10 independent collectors and never issues a verdict.
Notes: Directly addresses the system-level integration gap identified across P0003-P0023.

Statement: Introduces an append-only immutable EVxxxxxx evidence ledger (MOD005) paired with non-destructive reliability grading (MOD006), explicit conflict preservation, and programmatic sentence-level reasoning verification (MOD011 verify_sentence) achieving zero ungrounded prose.
Notes: Prevents silent overwrites and hallucinated forensic explanations.

Statement: Decouples empirical E4-calibrated prediction accuracy from evidence quality, system integrity, and combined decision confidence (MOD009), paired with an image-blind 4-way Decision Engine (MOD008: Real, Fake, Inconclusive, Unknown) that refuses forced binary verdicts under conflict or low reliability.
Notes: Distinguishes probability from forensic certainty in both API and UI.

Statement: Delivers end-to-end research-to-application provenance stamping (system, model, dataset, experiment, Git commit) across CLI/JSON/Markdown/HTML reports and a full-stack Django/React web app, with modality-extensible EvidenceCollector and FusionStrategy contracts (MOD018).
Notes: Bridges reproducible research registries directly into interactive forensic case investigation.

Statement: Contribution 1: A public-only, open-license, leakage-checked 5-dataset benchmark and preprocessing pipeline (DS0001-DS0005, PP0001-PP0006, 10 splits) supporting in-distribution, cross-dataset, frequency, bias, and leave-one-generator-out evaluation.

Notes: Passes Checklists 10, 11, and 12.

Notes: Passes Checklist 2; directly addresses GAP0008.

Statement: Three distinct detector backbones (ResNet-50 MODEL0001, EfficientNet-B4 MODEL0003, and ViT-B/16 MODEL0004) were trained under the fixed 224x224 SPLIT0001 fairness contract; remaining shortlisted candidates (Xception MODEL0002 at 299px, native-380px EfficientNet-B4, and CLIP/space-frequency encoders) were deferred.

Notes: Reinforces that the detector alone cannot serve as a forensic arbiter.
